logic.entry: Aggregate UTC daily high=max(all1440 closed minute highs),low=min(all1440 closed minute lows). At completed dayj use j-N..j inclusive(N+1daily ranges). For equal extrema choose most recent day. ah=j-index_high,al=j-index_low. Up=100*(N-ah)/N,Down=100*(N-al)/N,osc=Up-Down,Decimal28. First valid indexN;no future padding or fold reset. When flat, enter iff oscillator>entry_oscillator_threshold; strict boundary,no prior-cross requirement.
logic.exit: While long, exit iff oscillator<0. Zero preserves long; flat stays cash at or below entry threshold. No future padding, fold reset, short, hold cap or same-decision re-entry. Costed terminal liquidation.
logic.sizing: Independent 2,000 USDT cash account; all original capital allocated to this asset; long-only, no leverage, no borrowing, no cross-asset transfer or add-on.
logic.timing: Close-based signal only from a closed UTC daily bar, next day 00:01 UTC one-minute open (60-second delay); no historical fill before OOS.

parameters.impact_model: 0.5 * sample_stdev(previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns) * sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote-volume ADV)
